en.headline: Chief Executive says LegCo by-election lower priority than three major polls
en.dek: John Lee indicated that filling the seat vacated by former lawmaker William Wong Kam-fai ranks behind the Election Committee, chief executive and District Council elections scheduled over the next 18 months.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday that holding a by-election to fill the Legislative Council seat left vacant by the resignation of William Wong Kam-fai is a lower priority than three major elections due in the next 18 months.

Lee told reporters that electoral authorities must weigh the necessity of a by-election against manpower and logistics constraints. He said the priority must be successfully conducting the Election Committee subsector election in November, the chief executive election next March, and the District Council election towards the end of next year.

Wong resigned earlier this month after his arrest on suspicion of drink-driving and related offences linked to a traffic accident on the Chinese University of Hong Kong campus. The Legislative Council currently has 89 members following his departure.

zh.headline: 李家超指立法會補選優先次序低於三場重要選舉
zh.dek: 行政長官表示，填補前議員黃錦輝出缺議席的補選，在時間及工作量上優先於未來18個月的選委會、行政長官及區議會選舉。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二表示，就填補前立法會議員黃錦輝辭職後出缺議席舉行補選，優先次序低於未來18個月將舉行的三場重要選舉。
李家超指，選舉管理委員會須衡量補選的必要性，以及人力物力等實際情況。他說，從時間及工作量考慮，優先應辦好今年11月的選委會界別分組選舉、明年3月的行政長官選舉，以及明年年底的區議會選舉。
黃錦輝早前因涉嫌酒後駕駛及相關交通罪行被捕後辭任立法會議員，立法會現時有89名議員。
